cohort: Mothers of children under 5 years old in Tripura, India.
finding: Approximately two-thirds of mothers had good knowledge about breastfeeding, with educated mothers demonstrating better practices and urban mothers having a more positive attitude.
mod_finding: Institutional deliveries were positively associated with breastfeeding practices.
cross-section timing: At one point in time, among mothers of children aged under 5 years.
